title: test: scope the tree-wide pin scans to the extensions they judge
body:
Fixes #25321

## Summary

The four remaining tree-scan pin tests handed `git grep` (or `ls-files` + `grep`) all of
`packages/` and filtered to the files they judge afterwards, so a loaded runner paid for
hundreds of megabytes of non-source bytes per scan inside the pins' 60 s budget. This gives
each scan the pathspec of the extension it judges — the same shape PR #25319 used for the
runtime twin — so every pin judges the same file set while git reads only those files.

## Changes

- `packages/objectql/src/action-owner-key-single-source.test.ts`: the three full-tree greps
  become one extension-scoped multi-needle scan shared by both tree assertions; stale-site
  line reporting and the release-record/pin exemptions are unchanged.
- `packages/core/src/security/row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts`: one shared
  extension-scoped grep replaces the whole-tree scan; all matchers, comment filtering and
  caller classifications unchanged.
- `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts`: same shape; the
  arbiter prefilter, decision-site and wiring checks unchanged.
- `packages/core/src/security/operation-private-keys.pin.test.ts`: the content prefilter
  becomes one extension-scoped grep that includes `.tsx` on purpose, so the existing
  excluded-`.tsx`-declaration boundary assertion keeps its own discriminating population;
  the ordinary offender set stays `.ts` minus `.d.ts`, and the filename-only `ls-files`
  exclusion census is untouched.
- `packages/core/src/security/granted-permissions-not-enforced.pin.test.ts` already scopes
  its pathspecs (`.ts`/`.mts`) and is left unchanged.
- Every `SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000` is byte-identical to before: this is not a timeout
  raise. Ablation checks confirm each edited pin still goes red on a planted violation in
  a still-scanned path, and that the excluded-`.tsx` boundary assertion still fires on a
  planted excluded declaration.

## Testing

- The four edited pins pass locally (objectql 5/5; row-serving 3/3; second-object 4/4;
  operation-private-keys 5/5).
- Per-scanner ablations: a planted offending declaration/call in a still-scanned `.ts`
  path turns each pin red with its own assertion failure and is restored to green; a
  planted declaration in an excluded `.tsx` file still turns the boundary assertion red
  while the ordinary offender assertion stays green.
- Narrow ESLint over the touched files: clean.
- Full CI (build, sharded tests, docs, lint, typecheck) runs on this branch.

Tests-only change: per `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` the diff releases nothing, so
it is eligible for the `skip-changeset` exemption label — applying labels is not something
a fork PR can do for itself.

Authored by automated coding agents; per-commit authorship is recorded in the commits'
`Co-Authored-By` trailers.
